description: Search jokes by keyword or phrase. Returns matching jokes with categories, types, and content flags.

amount.description: Number of jokes to return. Defaults to 5.

category.description: Limit search to a category. One of: Any, Programming, Misc, Dark, Pun, Spooky, Christmas. Defaults to "Any".

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for within joke text.

safe_mode.description: When true (the default), only return jokes JokeAPI flags as safe. Set false to include Dark and other unsafe-flagged categories.

name: search_jokes
